title: Fix wrong bundled seed-asset filename (seed.db.gz) in docs/qa/legacy/14-sync-and-offline.md
rule: Tier-4 triage AREA NOTE — factual-drift check against reality for a presents-as-current doc

evidence.quote: 6. Content DB seed file (`seed.db.gz`) is available in the APK assets
**Preconditions:** Fresh install of the app. The APK contains `seed.db.gz` in assets.

why: A tester following SYNC-29 to verify the seed DB ships in the APK would run `unzip -l app-release.apk | grep seed.db.gz`, find nothing (the real bundled asset is content.db.gz — seed.db.gz is only a local build-only intermediate per tool/seed_content_db.dart), and could file a false 'seed file missing from APK' bug, burning triage time on a doc typo instead of a real defect.
recommendation: Replace both `seed.db.gz` mentions with `content.db.gz`, or add a one-line caveat that seed.db.gz is the pre-bundle build intermediate, never the shipped asset name — matching the correct usage already in the sibling seed-content-db-build-guide.md.
acceptance_criteria: Both occurrences of `seed.db.gz` in docs/qa/legacy/14-sync-and-offline.md (Prerequisites list and SYNC-29) read `content.db.gz` or are annotated as the build-only intermediate name.
grep -c 'seed.db.gz' docs/qa/legacy/14-sync-and-offline.md returns 0, or only appears inside an explicit build-intermediate caveat.
